mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (3-month change) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% each over the past month signals a broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline >1% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline >1% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO growth exceeding 1.0% month-over-month), the economy is expanding robustly, leading to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% m/m.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (3-month change) signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS has increased over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 3.5% (year-over-year) signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% y/y.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 0.5% each signals a deepening economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline >0.5% from prior quarter
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline >0.5% from prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% y/y), the Federal Reserve is actively combating inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% y/y.
